text:
mike: deploy finished to prod-usa at 11:02 PT — runtime image rwinf/runtime:v1.23.4 rolled. please run quick smoke checks (health / short-gen / p95). i'll watch metrics for 15m.
anya: running health and a few sample gens now. hitting /v1/health -> 200 OK. doing short 128-token samples.
deploy-bot: Deployment completed: rwinf/runtime:v1.23.4 -> prod-usa. canary 25% -> 100%. build: https://ci.redwood.ai/release/9876 :rocket:
cassi: did 6 sample requests, functional responses look good. noticed p95 latency up ~12ms on single-request path compared to baseline. logs show a small increase in `KVCache miss` events around 11:03.
samir: checking infra metrics — saw redis connection retries tick up right when canary hit 100% (counts: redis.retry=7 -> 23 over 5m). could be connection pooling pressure with the new runtime.
anya: running a quick latency script now (curl loop):
```
for i in {1..10}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{time_total}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=redwood-mini; done
```
first 5 runs: 0.18, 0.17, 0.19, 0.18, 0.34 (one spike at 0.34). rest similar to p50 baseline.
irene: tagging infra oncall @samir @mike — can you confirm redis circuit breakers and connection pool health?
samir: circuit breakers not tripping. one pool hitting ~120/128 connections briefly. increasing pool size or backlog should help. i'll prepare a small runtime config tweak (no rollback yet).
mike: prefer config patch first. rollout/rollback plan at hand if needed: rollback to v1.23.3 via canary traffic shift (50% -> 0% over 2m windows).
anya: updating dashboard: p50 stable, p95 +12ms, error rate steady. i'll run a 200-request smoke batch at +10m and report back.
cassi: i pushed a tiny runtime change to reduce max_wait from 120ms -> 80ms for the request queue to see if spikes reduce — monitoring now. :eyes:
samir: added a temporary autoscale policy to add 1 extra node when avg_conn > 100; policy will auto-remove after 30m. this is non-persistent emergency buffer.
mike: thanks. if error rate > 0.1% or 5xxs spike tag #incidents and escalate. otherwise keep updates here.
anya: after 10m smoke (200 reqs): 200/200 ok, p95 still ~+11ms, no increase in 5xx. bringing this to ops notes.
cassi: no functional regressions in quick tests. keeping a small watch on KVCache miss rate.
samir: infra will keep the temporary scale for 25 more minutes. will post if redis retries trend up again.
mike: followups: 1) create a short postmortem note if p95 persists past 1hr, 2) open a follow-up ticket to profile kv cache behavior under new runtime, 3) prefer config patch in next minor release if this recurs. thanks everyone.
